description: Defines the MonotonicCounter class for maintaining a 64-bit monotonic counter, with methods for updating, resetting, and rounding the counter, primarily used for tracking counters that may wrap or reset.

classes.name: MonotonicCounter
classes.description: A class to maintain a 64-bit monotonic counter, capable of handling 32-bit wrapping counters and providing methods for incrementing, updating, resetting, and rounding the counter.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current value of the counter.

methods.name: catchUpTo
methods.description: Advances the counter to match a given value if it is greater than the current counter.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increases the counter by a positive delta and returns the new value.

methods.name: update32
methods.description: Updates the 64-bit counter based on a 32-bit counter value, handling wrap-around scenarios.

methods.name: reset32
methods.description: Resets the stored 32-bit counter value to zero.

methods.name: roundUp64
methods.description: Rounds the 64-bit counter up to the nearest multiple of the specified period.
